hints.title: Digit Parity Count Invariant
hints.text: A fair integer must have an even total number of digits so that the count of even digits equals the count of odd digits.

hints.title: Length Elevation
hints.text: If the number of digits of n is odd, the smallest fair integer is 10^(len) with half zeros and half ones constructed greedily.

hints.title: Search Within Same Length
hints.text: Check candidate integers starting from n. Increment and count odd versus even digits until a balanced count is found or length increases.

hints.title: Fair Integer Search Implementation

variables: d: number of digits in n
k: steps to nearest fair integer
complexity.notes: Steps to the next balanced parity integer are small due to dense distribution.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Arbitrary backtracking without odd-length skipping tests invalid digit counts.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(d) string representation per tested candidate.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that odd length numbers instantly jump to the smallest balanced number of next length.
